findings.issue: HTTP authz surface (checkExplainAuthz, 403 EXPLAIN_FORBIDDEN, self-vs-admin, maskedFields stripping for self) has zero test coverage. AC-9/AC-10/AC-8-self claimed but unverified. This is the anti-oracle core of a PDP-core change.
findings.suggestion: Add HTTP-level tests: non-admin about foreign subject -> 403; self-query -> 200 without maskedFields; admin with mgmt_object:grant -> 200 with maskedFields.

findings.issue: effects/sod ports not wired into explainDeps, so for op in {invoke,approve,transition} explain.verdict diverges from production resolveFor (no_effect_grant / sod_violation never reached). Endpoint accepts all 7 operations. Violates central AC-1 (verdict agreement).
findings.suggestion: Either wire the same effects/sod ports as production PDP, or restrict VALID_OPS to {read} (documented) until other ops are faithful.

findings.issue: Stub RecordSource always returns non-null sentinel, so the record_fetch step in the live endpoint can never report not_found -- the trace lies about the record stage (always green). AC-6 unreachable via HTTP; limitation undeclared in the response.
findings.suggestion: Read the real record (or its existence) for a faithful record_fetch step, or explicitly mark record_fetch as stubbed/non-diagnostic in the response.

findings.issue: The property test compares resolveFor-with-trace vs resolveFor-without-trace on identical deps -- validates NF-1 (non-mutation), not AC-1 (endpoint verdict == production PDP). Case matrix is read-only; no invoke/approve/transition.
findings.suggestion: Add a test asserting endpoint verdict against the real production dep set on non-read operations (depends on R-2).

findings.issue: `eslint src` exits 1: unused isNarrowerOrEqual (40), isEffective (41), UUID_RE (57). `npm run ci` runs `eslint src` so the CI lower bound is red. Reviewer rule 2 -> automatic changes_requested.
findings.suggestion: Remove the unused imports and the unused UUID_RE constant.

findings.issue: Without DB the route is not registered (`if (grantsPool)`), so the request returns 404, but ADR §3.4/AC-11 require 503 NO_DATABASE.
findings.suggestion: Register the route unconditionally and return 503 when the pool is absent, or amend the ADR/AC-11.

role_gap_evidence: Anti-oracle / authz on a PDP-core change shipped with zero HTTP-level tests (R-1) despite being the most security-sensitive surface; candidate evidence for a dedicated security-reviewer gate (SQ11) and for a fitness check that the explain endpoint's verdict provably equals the production PDP verdict (not just trace-non-mutation).
